description:
On the Day of Atonement in Leviticus, the Israelites were to practice self-denial. What did that look like then and how do we apply it today? With John Dinzey, Daniel Morikone, and James Rafferty. Hosted by Idalia Dinzey.


Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 
By text: (618) 228-3975

QUESTIONS COVERED:

1. Who wrote the book of Hebrews? 

2. When making important decisions, is it not okay for me to say my prayers out loud or write them? The enemy might know it and use it to deceive me. How about regular prayers? should I just pray in my mind? What's the best way to pray?

 3. How do you get three days and three nights from the traditional teaching that the crucifixion of Jesus took place on Friday and the resurrection took place on Sunday? How is it figured three days between the Crucifixion and the Resurrection? 

4. Does God come with Jesus at the Second Coming? 

5. The Bible states in Nahum 1:9 that sin will not rise up a second time. Why did sin arise in the first place? Why is there so much suffering just to demonstrate that sin is detrimental? Why does sin exist?

6. Is Jesus with the dying in their final moments of life? Is there a moment when the dying can accept Jesus Christ as his or her Lord and Saviour? 

7. Can you explain Hebrews 8: 7-13? 

8. What are the Holy Ghost's duties in our lives? 

9. 1 Kings 21:29 says "Have you noticed how Ahab has humbled himself before me? Because he has humbled himself, I will not bring this disaster in his day, but I will bring it on his house in the days of his son.” Why does God show mercy to the one who is guilty and knows what they have done yet reserves the punishment for the children who might not even know why they are being punished? Can you please explain 1 Kings 21:29?

10. The Bible refers to the body of Christ & the bride of Christ, are these the same? What scriptures can I look at to better understand what these terms mean? Is the Body of Christ and the Bride of Christ the same?

 11. Had Lucifer fallen before the creation of Eden? If no, please explain the first part of Ezekiel 28:13. 

12. On the Day of Atonement in Leviticus, the Israelites were to practice self-denial. What did that look like then and how do we apply it today? What does self-denial look like?
